description: Revives an ally with 20% HP while out of combat. Consumes 1 item on successful use. Proposed effect for an executionId handler.

name: Fire Bomb
description: Deals 60 fire damage within a radius of 250 Unreal units. Consumes 1 item on successful use. Proposed effect for an executionId handler.

name: Frost Bomb
description: Deals 40 cold damage within a radius of 250 Unreal units and slows affected targets by 20% for 3 seconds. Consumes 1 item on successful use. Proposed effect for an executionId handler.

name: Elixir of Fire Resistance
description: Grants 10 fireRes for 60 seconds. Reuse refreshes the duration. Consumes 1 item on successful use. Proposed effect for an executionId handler.

name: Elixir of Cold Resistance
description: Grants 10 coldRes for 60 seconds. Reuse refreshes the duration. Consumes 1 item on successful use. Proposed effect for an executionId handler.

name: Elixir of Lightning Resistance
description: Grants 10 lightningRes for 60 seconds. Reuse refreshes the duration. Consumes 1 item on successful use. Proposed effect for an executionId handler.
